steps.text:
Hey Schatz,
we finally made it after such a long time! 🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉🎉

I still can't believe it that the waiting has finally come to an end and I missed you so much during that time ❤️
 Tomorrow we will hold each other, arm in arm again, like we used to almost 6 months ago 💕 
It seriously feels like it's not real and probably only at the airport, when we see each other in person, we will realize that we are finally together again ❤️

Everything came so sudden now, since we were busy with making plans, preparing for living together next year and busy with our lives in general.
But even if the trip feels a bit soon now - at least I would've like to plan a little bit more - I have no doubt that we will make it an unforgettable vacation for us both ❤️

We had many ups, but recently, unfortunately, many downs too. 
I know I can be very persistent sometimes when arguing and also you didn't say the nicest things, but I really want us to try our best and achieve the future that we always dreamed about ✨
When arguing, I always try my best to improve and when I point out something from you, I hope for you to do the same. So let's keep improving together until we both can comfortably life together 💕

Do you remember our last day we saw each other in person? This picture was the last one I took from you before leaving Japan and I think it's very cute 😊

 At that time we both couldn't realize how hard a long distance relationship would be and we didn't realize how long this 6 Months would feel. Our last goodbye just felt like we won't see each other again for just a couple days.

Only when I left Osaka I slowly realized how far and long we will actually be apart. I left you a letter before I left, since I knew I won't be able to say everything I was thinking when we say goodbye.
You called me right away and I was really glad you liked it 🥰
I finally had the chance to tell you what I was actually feeling and to reassure you for the upcoming months that lied ahead of us. The next day, I realized how long we won't be able to see each other and it really frightened me.

At first, the long distance relationship didn't feel difficult. 
We laughed and smiled everyday, found something new to spend time online almost every day and the feeling of not being together physically was very manageable. It was still sad not being able to be together at first, but later this feeling grew very big.
We even managed to somewhat attend the debutant ball together.I really hope next year we actually can do that together 💕
The first two months really flew by and we experienced so many things together, like eating together 🍴

Our love grew more and more each day, even though we just saw each other online.
You also made me such a wonderful present for my birthday, I'm still thinking about it now many times 🎁
 It made me very happy how much thought you put in and especially the personal things like the cards, the teddy bear and your letter were truly amazing ☺️

Thank you again for putting so much effort in it ❤️

Even online we still had many exciting date nights.
One I enjoyed in particular was when you showed me the fireworks in Osaka and we ordered food for each other🐔🎆
It was my first time seeing japanese fireworks and the food you ordered for me was so good 😋

So let's enjoy our trip in Europe and understand each other more in the upcoming 6 months we will be together 🥰🥰

I hope you have a save and super pleasant flight to Europe ✈️
Hopefully, your jetlag won't be too severe, but I already planned the first days through, so just relax and let me take over 😉
I will be waiting for you at the airport with some cheese and chocolate 🧀🍫 And don't worry... You didn't need to remember what you wanted to say at the airport 😄

See you in Germany!

Love you sooooooooooooooo much,
 Till❤️
